title: Nanite Swarm
about: Replicate, consume, expand. Command a swarm of self-replicating nanites as they devour planetary resources and spread your automated network across the stars.

controls.desc: Select controls, inspect tiles, and build
Pan the planetary grid and scroll lists
Harvest, filter, or sell the selected tile
Open Research, Ship, Map, and Menu
Pause, change speed, cancel, and show help
